doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR003: Application shall provide a file picker dialog for video import. This requirement mandates native file picker integration via Electron for importing MP4, MOV, and WebM formats.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: IPC channel naming uses kebab-case (e.g., 'open-file-dialog'). All handlers return IPCResponse format with success/error structure. Main process handles all file system operations via IPC for security.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: User-friendly error messages: 'Export failed. Please try again.' Technical errors logged with context prefix [Main] or [Renderer]. All operations use try-catch with IPCResponse error format.

doc.title: Epic Breakdown
doc.snippet: File picker dialog must filter to MP4, MOV, WebM only. Multi-file selection enabled with properties: ['openFile', 'multiSelections']. Loading indicator required for batch imports.

doc.title: Story 2.1 - Drag-and-Drop Video Import
doc.snippet: Existing import-file IPC channel validates files using file.service.ts with FFprobe metadata extraction. Thumbnail generation via thumbnail.service.ts. mediaStore manages imported files state.

artifact.reason: Contains Import button implementation with handleImportClick handler. Already implements file picker dialog integration with loading state management.
IPC handler for open-file-dialog channel. Uses Electron dialog.showOpenDialog with video file filters and multi-selection support.
Reusable IPC handler for validating and importing individual video files. Called by file picker for each selected file.
Zustand store with isImporting state, addFiles batch action, and file management. Used by Sidebar for import progress indication.
Video file validation service using FFprobe. Extracts metadata (duration, resolution, format) for imported files.
FFmpeg-based thumbnail generation service. Extracts video frames for media library display.
Shared type definitions and IPC channel constants. Defines OPEN_FILE_DIALOG channel and MediaFile interface.

runtime.package: Desktop app framework - provides dialog API for native file picker

main_process.package: FFmpeg binaries for video validation and thumbnail generation

renderer.package: Tailwind class merging for cn() utility

constraints.constraint: All file operations must occur in main process via IPC for security (Electron security best practice)
Use Zustand for state management - no Redux or Context API (Architecture Decision ADR-001)
Use Tailwind CSS for styling - no separate CSS files (Architecture Decision ADR-003)
All IPC handlers must return IPCResponse format with success/error structure
IPC channel names use kebab-case convention (e.g., 'open-file-dialog')
Store file paths as absolute paths only - never relative paths
Supported video formats: MP4, MOV, WebM only (FR003)
Log all operations with context prefix: [Main] or [Renderer]
User-friendly error messages - hide technical details from user
Components must follow PascalCase naming, services use camelCase.service.ts
72-hour sprint timeline - pragmatic solutions over perfect architecture

interface.name: open-file-dialog IPC Channel
interface.description: Opens Electron dialog.showOpenDialog with video filters ['mp4', 'mov', 'webm'] and multiSelections property. Returns array of selected file paths or empty array if cancelled.

interface.name: import-file IPC Channel
interface.description: Validates video file using file.service.ts, generates thumbnail via thumbnail.service.ts, returns MediaFile object with metadata. Reused by both drag-and-drop and file picker imports.

interface.name: window.api.openFileDialog
interface.description: Renderer-exposed API for triggering file picker dialog. Calls open-file-dialog IPC channel.

interface.name: mediaStore.setIsImporting
interface.description: Controls import loading state. Set to true when file picker returns paths, false when all imports complete.

interface.name: mediaStore.addFiles
interface.description: Batch adds multiple MediaFile objects to store. Used after file picker imports complete.

tests.standards: Vitest test runner with @testing-library/react for component testing. Mock window.api for IPC calls using vi.fn(). Reset Zustand stores in beforeEach using store.setState(). Test files colocated in __tests__ folders. Name pattern: ComponentName.test.tsx. Reference acceptance criteria in test descriptions (e.g., 'AC: #1'). Use waitFor for async operations. Mock MediaFile objects for predictable test data.
